name: BXGY combo discount
description: Discounts both product groups when they are purchased together, up to the quantities you set.
title: Discount value
intro: When a customer adds both groups, the discount applies to Customer buys and Customer gets. Only the quantities you set are discounted, so an extra unit stays full price.
repeat: Each additional complete set is discounted too, unless you set a maximum number of uses. For a limited quantity, the lowest-priced units are discounted.

customerBuys.label: Customer buys
customerBuys.help: Customers must add the quantity of items specified below. These items and the Customer gets items both receive the discount.

customerGets.label: Customer gets
customerGets.help: Customers must add the quantity of items specified below as well. These items and the Customer buys items both receive the discount.

discountValue.label: At a discounted value
discountValue.help: The same value applies to each discounted unit in both groups.

maxUses.label: Set a maximum number of uses per order
maxUses.help: Each use discounts one set of the quantities above.

errors.summary: Complete the required fields before saving.
errors.quantity: Enter a whole number greater than 0.
errors.percentage: Enter a percentage greater than 0 and up to 100.
errors.tooManyProducts: You can add up to 100 products.
errors.tooManyCollections: You can add up to 100 collections.
errors.maxUses: Enter a whole number of uses greater than 0.
errors.save: Unable to save this discount. Try again.
errors.discountClass: Unable to set this discount to products. Try again.
